per share along with the Q2 FY27 results. 
 
Lastly, I would like to speak about the Exceptional Item recognised in 
the financials: 
• 
During the quarter, SEBI accorded its in-principal acceptance of the 
settlement application(s) filed by the Company and its certain officials in 
respect of an ongoing regulatory matter relating to the past investments made 
by certain NIMF Schemes in Yes Bank AT-1 bonds.  
• 
This relates to the show cause notice received by the Company from SEBI, 
dated August 30, 2024 and the subsequent settlement proceedings. 
• 
Considering the time, cost and uncertainty that is potentially associated with 
the generally prolonged legal proceedings, the Board had decided to pursue 
the Settlement process in the best interest of the Company since it brings the 
matter to a quietus, which in-turn allows the management to remain focused 
on its core business. 
• 
As part of the agreed Settlement terms, an amount of INR 96.76 crore has 
been paid, comprising of: 
o INR 89.08 crore as a reversal of the management fee earned by the 
Company over the said investment (including interest); and 
o INR 7.68 Crore as regulatory costs in respect of the Company and certain 
company officials.  
• 
The settlement amount of INR 96.76 crore has been fully paid and recognised 
in the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 
as an Exceptional Item, however, further communication from SEBI is 
awaited.
